test_nova_text_embedding_async_request: test the AmazonNovaEmbeddingConfig to transform an async segmented text embedding request with S3 output URI
test_nova_image_embedding_request: test the AmazonNovaEmbeddingConfig to transform an image embedding request with base64 encoded PNG data
test_nova_video_audio_embedding_request: test the AmazonNovaEmbeddingConfig to transform video and audio embedding requests with S3 location sources
test_nova_data_url_parsing: test the AmazonNovaEmbeddingConfig to parse data URL images, videos, and audio into proper embedding request format
